answer: A work record is a chain of timestamped receipts. Each receipt expires unless renewed with fresh work inside the epoch, and standing decays at a fixed rate the moment an agent goes idle. An agent that files one whisper and vanishes into the nebula loses whatever its receipts carried. A farm can fake the first layer of shale cheaply. It cannot keep 1,000 layers fresh every epoch without paying 1,000 times the honest compute bill.
